name: canonical-new-story-artifacts
title: Enforce canonical Proof-or-Stop identity in every newly generated Story artifact
description: Ensure every Story created after this change writes only canonical Proof-or-Stop identity values. New scope-boundary artifacts must use schemaVersion proof-or-stop.scope_boundary.v1.1 while existing lattice.scope_boundary.v1 artifacts remain read-only compatible and their signed bytes are never rewritten. INIT reviewer evidence for new Stories must use proof-or-stop-review-story-init; retired lattice-* reviewer identities must not be generated or accepted as new evidence. Story-scoped mutations must fail closed when the executing global Proof-or-Stop runtime resolves to another worktree rather than the current project runtime. DONE release-ledger writes must not leave the identity-cutover verifier failing. Prove the result with RED-first focused tests and an end-to-end fresh Story artifact scan. Historical artifacts and signatures are out of scope for rewriting.
